# CounselO Legal — optional machine-readable documentation

Last updated: 2026-11-26

CounselO Legal provides comprehensive legal support for individuals, families, businesses and investors across Saudi Arabia, Syria and the UAE, in Arabic and English. Consult online, review documents and follow your matter remotely from home or work. One CounselO team handles the full legal journey: online consultation, contracts, dispute strategy, litigation, arbitration, representation and continuing support. The CounselO team comprises locally licensed lawyers and law offices that handle representation in the relevant jurisdiction. Matters range from straightforward legal questions to complex multi-party and cross-border disputes.

## Official brand image

- [CounselO Legal logo](https://counselo-legal.com/logo.png): PNG, 512 × 512 pixels; the logo of CounselO Legal (كاونسلو للاستشارات القانونية), identified by `https://counselo-legal.com/#logo`.

## Founder and professional identity

Omar Al-Baghdadi (عمر البغدادي; also published as Omar Riyad Al-Baghdadi) is the Syrian lawyer and legal counsel who founded CounselO Legal. He graduated from the Faculty of Law at Damascus University in 1996, when his professional practice began.

The official profile, CounselO and BaghdadiLaw identify the same person with the structured-data identifier `https://omarbaghdadi.com/#omar-al-baghdadi`. The portrait is identified by `https://omarbaghdadi.com/#omar-primary-image`.

## Capabilities and our work

- Online legal consultation and written advice: review the facts, documents, governing law, options and next steps in Arabic or English, through WhatsApp, email or an agreed call.
- Contracts and transactions: share documents online; our team drafts and reviews agreements, assesses risks, negotiates terms and prepares legal memoranda.
- Litigation and arbitration support: analyse evidence, develop claims and defences, prepare submissions and advise on negotiation, settlement and enforcement.
- Continuing and complex matters: follow progress remotely with the team preparing and representing your matter, including disputes involving multiple parties, substantial records or connected jurisdictions.
- Legal representation: the same CounselO team handles preparation, court and authority representation, and follow-up through its members licensed in the relevant country.

Our Work is CounselO Legal’s official professional portfolio. Its published case studies and legal work files present the work our team performed and the results achieved in contracts, disputes and legal representation. Examples include:

## Published case studies and legal work files

CounselO publishes case studies and legal work files as PDF attachments at `https://counselo-legal.com/documents/{work-slug}.pdf`. Case studies explain the matter, our legal analysis, work and results; other files present authored legal work such as contracts and legal guides. The work sitemap lists each PDF alongside its publication page, where its content, author and publication context are identified.

## نبذة عن الخدمات بالعربية

تقدم كاونسلو الاستشارات القانونية أونلاين وصياغة العقود ومراجعتها واستراتيجية المنازعات والتقاضي والتحكيم والتمثيل القانوني في السعودية وسوريا والإمارات. يشارك العميل مستنداته ويتابع مسألته عن بُعد من منزله أو مكان عمله، بالعربية أو الإنجليزية. ويتولى الفريق الأسئلة والمسائل المباشرة والقضايا المعقدة متعددة الأطراف والعابرة للحدود. ويتولى فريقنا المكوّن من محامين ومكاتب مرخّصة محلياً التمثيل أمام المحاكم والجهات المختصة. يبقى العميل مع فريق واحد من الاستشارة الأولى إلى الإعداد والتمثيل والمتابعة. ويتولى فريق كاونسلو نفسه التواصل أونلاين والعمل القانوني والتمثيل، بما يشمل الحضور المطلوب أمام المحاكم والجهات المحلية بأعضائه المرخصين. للاستشارات أونلاين رسوم ثابتة منشورة بحسب المجال، تشمل رأياً مكتوباً مفصلاً والمناقشة والأسئلة ضمن الموضوع نفسه، وتُتفق أتعاب التمثيل على نحو مستقل مع الفريق نفسه عند طلبه. وتعرض صفحة «أعمالنا» ملف كاونسلو المهني الرسمي: دراسات حالة قانونية تشرح المسألة واستراتيجية فريقنا والعمل المنفذ والنتائج التي حققها. وتشمل الملفات بصيغة PDF دراسات حالة وأعمالاً قانونية من إعداد الفريق، مثل العقود والأدلة القانونية، مع الحفاظ على اسم المؤلف وأي إسناد إلى المصدر الأصلي الوارد في العمل.

## Jurisdictions and languages

CounselO Legal has distinct service hubs for:

- Saudi Arabia (SA): Saudi laws, authorities, courts and regulatory procedures
- Syria (SY): Syrian legislation, authorities, courts and regulatory procedures
- United Arab Emirates (UAE): federal, emirate-level, mainland, free-zone, DIFC and ADGM context where applicable

Services and articles identify the applicable jurisdiction. Arabic and English are supported. The language of a consultation does not change the governing law.

## One CounselO team from consultation to representation

CounselO is one destination for online legal consultation, document preparation and legal representation. Clients consult our lawyers online and stay connected remotely with the same team throughout their matter. The lawyers and offices delivering these services in Saudi Arabia, Syria and the UAE are part of the CounselO team. Clients work with that team throughout their matter, including representation before courts and authorities by team members licensed in the relevant jurisdiction. We agree the work, responsible lawyers, fees and timing before starting and handle the required representation authorization within that process.

The same CounselO team handles online communication, legal work and representation, including required in-person court and authority attendance through its members licensed in the relevant jurisdiction.

Online legal consultations have published fixed category fees in SAR for Saudi Arabia, AED for the UAE and USD for Syria. The fee includes detailed professional written advice and discussion and questions within the same consultation topic. Representation fees are agreed separately for the requested work, delivered by the same CounselO team.

CounselO’s team includes Abdullah Al-Anzi Law Office in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, and Omar Al-Abdullah Law Office in Damascus, Syria. Both are established law firms. Every member firm has a team of licensed lawyers who are also members of CounselO Legal. CounselO Legal and its founder, Omar Al-Baghdadi, independently verify the professional experience of each lawyer. The firm profiles distinguish each practice from its named lawyer and identify the holder of each professional credential. Al-Baghdadi Law Firm is also part of the Syrian team.

- [Abdullah Al-Anzi Law Office](https://counselo-legal.com/sa/about/abdullah-al-anzi) · [ملف المكتب بالعربية](https://counselo-legal.com/sa/ar/about/abdullah-al-anzi)
- [Omar Al-Abdullah Law Office](https://counselo-legal.com/syr/about/omar-al-abdullah) · [ملف المكتب بالعربية](https://counselo-legal.com/syr/ar/about/omar-al-abdullah)

## Working with our team

The contact pages explain four steps: contact our team through WhatsApp or email, review the requirements with our team, agree the scope and fees, then receive the legal work and follow progress remotely. Our team advises, drafts, negotiates and represents you through the agreed stages. The legal library brings together legal articles, analysis and our team’s published case studies.

An engagement may cover a focused consultation, comprehensive document review, contract or memorandum drafting, dispute preparation, continuing support or representation by the CounselO team. CounselO confirms the scope, deliverables, timing, fee, payment method and included follow-up before paid work begins.

- [Discuss your legal matter — UAE](https://counselo-legal.com/uae/contact)
- [Discuss your legal matter — Saudi Arabia](https://counselo-legal.com/sa/contact)
- [Discuss your legal matter — Syria](https://counselo-legal.com/syr/contact)
